title: OpenDEA Maturity Evaluation Model
description: The model-owned evaluation contract for a maturity model (CR-AM-09 §6): how criteria are evaluated, what evidence is required, which native scoring mechanism and domain apply, and what feeds level resolution. Native evaluation stays model-owned — no universal 0–100: a model may score 0–5, 0–10, percentage, weighted index, categorical, boolean conformance, multi-dimensional vector, rubric, or custom, and the metamodel never normalizes scores onto a universal scale. CriterionLevelExpectation lets each criterion state how it manifests at each level (maturity is demonstrated through progressive behavior change, not merely a score). Scores never imply levels — level attribution is the Phase 3 LevelResolutionRule's concern over this model's outputs.

scale.description: The MaturityScale this evaluation model feeds (id + version). Level references inside criteria must resolve within that scale (conformance-enforced).

scoring.description: The model's native scoring contract: mechanism + domain. Never normalized by the metamodel.

domain.description: The native score domain. Numeric domains carry explicit min/max; non-numeric domains carry labels or a model-defined contract.

custom_definition.description: Required when mechanism or domain.kind is 'custom'.

aggregation_rule.description: Model-declared aggregation across criteria (e.g. weighted mean with declared weights).

criteria.description: The evaluation criteria with their per-level expectations (CriterionLevelExpectation, CR-AM-09 §4: maturity is demonstrated through progressive behavior change, not merely a score).

mandatory.description: Mandatory gate criterion (mandatory-criterion mechanism) — the level cannot be reached without it regardless of aggregate score.

level_expectations.description: How this criterion manifests at each scale level. Level ids must resolve within the referenced scale (conformance-enforced).

level.description: The level id within the referenced MaturityScale.

expectation.description: The behavior expected at that level for this criterion.

level_resolution_inputs.description: What the Phase 3 LevelResolutionRule consumes from this model's outputs (e.g. criterion-scores, mandatory-criteria, evidence-confidence). Declared here; resolution ships in Phase 3.
